cover_letter_text:
Hello,
I am applying for the Junior Project Manager role advertised on SEEK. Your advert lists sewer and water infrastructure, roadworks and land development projects, mostly for State and Local Government authorities and local developers.

From April 2019 to February 2020 I worked on site in the Philippines as project-in-charge and then field engineer. As project-in-charge I helped deliver a community hall renovation within its six-month construction program. I coordinated 10 to 15 workers each day, tracked progress and kept clients up to date. As field engineer I tracked procurement and materials and prepared site reports, material records and progress reports. I hold a Bachelor of Science in Civil Engineering (Philippines, 2019). In February 2026 I completed the Advanced Diploma of Civil Construction Design, where I designed and documented road geometry, earthworks, pavement and stormwater drainage. Coursework also covered cost estimates and bills of quantities.

I am based in Melton VIC. I can start two weeks after an offer. Full working rights in Australia (Subclass 485 visa), no sponsorship needed. I have a full Victorian driver's licence, my own transport and a White Card. Could we set a time for a call?
Marc Masarate

questions.question: Which of the following statements best describes your right to work in Australia?
questions.answer: Subclass 485 Temporary Graduate visa with full working rights until December 2027. No sponsorship needed.

questions.question: What's your expected annual base salary?
